QuestInfo.name: [Mechanical Hearts] Lost Friends
QuestInfo.0: #bSephia#k wants your help. Go and see her.
QuestInfo.1:
#bSephia#k tells you about a Wondroid she depended on who disappeared one day.
According to Spencer's data, she was last seen somewhere in the basement of #bAspire industries#k.
Sneak in and #binvestigate#k through #bSpencer#k and find the wandering Wondroid, #bNo. RX1073#k.
#r(#eNote: #nLocate and defeat Roxxy to fulfill your mission.)#k
QuestInfo.2: You found #bRoxxy#k wandering Aspire labs. Now she's been moved to the Recycling queue.\r\nYou need to go back and rescue her.

0.msg: You still haven't found #bRoxxy#k?\r\nHer serial is #bNo. RX1073#k...\r\nShe must be wandering somewhere in Aspire's basement. Perform an #r[Investigation]#k through #bSpencer#k and find her!
